defs.meaning: 激励（energize 的现在分词）；通电

examples.en: Acupuncture has a harmonizing and energizing effect on mind and body.
examples.zh: 针灸疗法有协调和激活身心的功效。

examples.en: "It's draining and de-energizing when people are in an environment and they just have to salute and not be themselves," he says.
examples.zh: 他说：“当人们处在一个只需要敬礼而不需要做自己的环境中时，会让人精疲力竭、失去活力。”

examples.en: Shades of red are energizing and intimate.
examples.zh: 红色可让人觉得有活力和亲切感。
